description: This file provides backward compatibility shims and class aliases for the SuiteCRM project, specifically for the OneLogin SAML2 library, Zend OAuth provider, and Html2Text library. It defines class aliases for legacy class names to new namespaces and creates fallback classes for deprecated references.
